purpose: Prove the Cousteau round-trip acoustic inference pipeline on progressively harder known controls before permitting interpretation of the frozen LOVE-EDEM Africa point.

round_trip_model.equation: Y(f) = X(f) * H_tx(f) * S_target(f,theta_in,theta_out) * H_rx(f) + N(f)
round_trip_model.interpretation: Recover or marginalize the emitted field and both ocean-path legs before inferring the residual target/scatterer operator.

experiment_ladder.meaning: Software-only sanity check that the inversion can recover a deliberately injected resonant transfer function under known noise and path conditions.
pass_gate: recover injected modal structure within preregistered tolerance
recover ringdown/group-delay class
reject wrong geometry controls
experiment_ladder.failure_meaning: STOP. Core inversion is not trustworthy even under controlled conditions.

experiment_ladder.meaning: Real-physics mechanism control showing that resonance-rich transformed echoes from a submerged engineered body can be recognized without implying any particular target identity.
inputs: published or measured submerged-shell acoustic response
pass_gate: detect resonance-rich transformed return
separate source illumination from target response
retain geometry ambiguity unless independently constrained
experiment_ladder.failure_meaning: Pipeline lacks sensitivity to a known transformed-echo mechanism.

experiment_ladder.meaning: Demonstrate specificity by forcing the pipeline to survive strong natural and biological acoustic confounds before it is allowed to call a target anomalous.
pass_gate: no admission from a single ~520 Hz line
full modal/phase/decay structure outranks absolute frequency
biological cavity resonance is not promoted to engineered geometry

experiment_ladder.meaning: First full end-to-end real-ocean exam using a large known metallic wreck with independently known fixed location, geometry, materials, environmental survey data and multi-epoch imaging/sonar ground truth.
blindness_contract: do_not provide Titanic name to the inference stage
do not provide known wreck coordinates to the localization stage
do not provide 3D model or true dimensions before reconstruction is frozen
do not tune thresholds after viewing ground truth
pass_gate: localization error within preregistered bound
stable Earth-fixed focus across independent passes
geometry class and principal dimensions recovered above preregistered score
withheld pass forward replay succeeds
material/scattering interpretation remains compatible with known metallic wreck without using material truth as an input
environmental path correction materially improves consistency or is shown unnecessary by a justified reciprocity/path test
experiment_ladder.failure_meaning: STOP BEFORE AFRICA INTERPRETATION. If Cousteau cannot recover a known wreck blindly, anomalous Africa returns are not trustworthy as target inference.

experiment_ladder.meaning: Run the same already-frozen pipeline at the LOVE-EDEM bisector point without moving the point or retuning the detector to whatever appears there.
pass_gate: candidate survives preregistered thresholds
candidate has stable geodetic focus
candidate repeats across independent observations where available
candidate exhibits residual structure not explained by X, H_tx, H_rx or known controls
experiment_ladder.failure_meaning: Record negative or ambiguous result without recentering.

experiment_ladder.meaning: Compare the Africa-point output against nearby eastern South Atlantic natural structures known to create unusual acoustic/backscatter signatures, including pockmarks, gas/hydrate systems, carbonates and fluid-flow features.
pass_gate: candidate is quantitatively distinguishable from matched natural geoacoustic controls
difference is based on full transfer/morphology/phase/decay/geodetic evidence rather than one frequency peak
experiment_ladder.failure_meaning: Prefer natural geoacoustic explanation or keep AMBIGUOUS.

experiment_ladder.meaning: Final anti-overfit gate: replay the frozen model on observations not used for thresholding, localization, geometry selection or interpretation.
inputs: withheld Africa observation or matched independent field
pass_gate: predeclared metrics remain above threshold
geodetic localization remains stable
modal/phase/decay fingerprint reproduces within tolerance
wrong-model controls continue to fail
experiment_ladder.failure_meaning: Downgrade prior pass to OVERFIT_OR_NONREPLICATING; preserve receipt.

minimum_desired_fields: complex I/Q return if available, otherwise highest-fidelity calibrated amplitude/phase product
phase reference or enough metadata to reconstruct relative phase
independent pass reserved as withheld data
titanic_data_acquisition_gate.rule: Do not fabricate missing resonance data; infer only what the raw/near-raw dataset supports.
